result.topic_en: Scattered notes: inequality conditions involving $\frac{k^2}{1+f}$ and $v^2+w^2$ (special case $f=-1$), an exponential ansatz, the equation of a line, a sketch of a curved region, the heat equation with its Gaussian integral solution for given initial data, and functional relations $f(-x)=f(x)$ and $\Gamma(n)=n\Gamma(n-1)$.
result.transcription:
$\frac{k^2}{1+f} > v^2+w^2$;
$\xi = \xi_0$,
$\frac{k^2}{1+f} < v^2+w^2$

$\xi = A e^{ux + vy + \dots}$
$f = -1$;
$\frac{k^2}{1+f}\ \infty > v^2+w^2$
$\frac{\xi-\xi_0}{A} = \frac{\eta-\eta_0}{B}$

[figure: curved region bounded by lines and curves, with a hatched segment near the top; labels illegible]

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = aa\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$
[-f-] $t=0$ $u=f(x)$
$u = \frac{2}{\sqrt{\pi}[?]}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-\frac{(x-\lambda)^2}{4aat}} f(\lambda)\,\partial\lambda$

[figure: line segment divided into parts]

$f(-x) = f(x)$,
$\Gamma(n) = n\,\Gamma(n-1)$

methods.what: Case distinction on the sign of $\frac{k^2}{1+f}-(v^2+w^2)$
Equation of a straight line in symmetric form
One-dimensional heat equation with initial condition
Solution of the heat equation by Gaussian (Poisson) integral of initial data
Functional recurrence of the factorial/Gamma-type function
